title: Steady states and dynamics of a higher dimensional thin film equation
summary: We study a higher-dimensional thin film equation that incorporates competitive effects between aggregation and repulsion, where repulsion is modeled by fourth-order diffusion and aggregation by backward second-order degenerate diffusion, with a degenerate diffusion exponent $m>0$. We first conduct a systematic analysis of the existence and geometric properties of steady-state solutions for all $m>0$, revealing a critical threshold $m^*=(d+2)/(d-2)$ for variational compactness and solution structure.
